_comment: Prefer: `deckhand hooks install claude-code` (writes an absolute path to the deckhand binary). Manual install: merge the `hooks` block into ~/.claude/settings.json. Each event pipes Claude Code's stdin JSON to `deckhand hooks ingest claude-code`, which attaches $ITERM_SESSION_ID and POSTs to Core using config.toml / env for auth — no curl, jq, or DECKHAND_API_KEY in the shell profile. Replace DECKHAND_BIN with `which deckhand` output if installing by hand.
_requires: deckhand CLI on PATH at install time (absolute path is written into the command)
